attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"both sides still fighting over Dunwold","reason":"Briefing says the Empire took Dunwold; it gives no ongoing fight over it."},{"span":"Militias at Harlow Ford are reportedly gathering again","reason":"This presents already-reported news as happening again."},{"span":"the rumor mill back in the capital","reason":"No capital is named or mentioned in the briefing."}],"voice":2,"clarity":3,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"The bulletin opens with a copied 'News since your last bulletin:' heading, which breaks character. It also recasts old news as current: Dunwold is described as still contested and Harlow Ford as gathering 'again', and it invents a capital. Most of the rest is a flat list of faction counts with little of Ilse's dry wit."}
